must_not: alias lt lists one entry per line
q: Which shell alias shows a tree view?
task: A teammate wants one keystroke for a tree view of the current directory. Which README alias does that, what full lsd flag does it expand to, and where do such aliases live?

must_not: icons can only be overridden by extension
q: What are the three icon override kinds?
task: The default folder glyph bugs you and you want a folder emoji for all directories. Which icons.yaml override kind changes every directory at once, and what are the other two override kinds?

q: What does the git flag show for directories?
task: You want version-control status next to each listing entry. Which lsd flag shows git status, and how is a directory status computed from the files inside it?

q: How do you get an extended metadata table?
task: Plain listing hides owners, sizes and dates. Which flag shows extended file metadata as a table, and which option names the blocks shown and their order, including the git block?

q: How do you bound a tree listing?
task: A deep node_modules tree floods the terminal. Which flag presents the listing as a tree, and which flag stops it recursing past a given depth?

q: How do you sort by time, size, or flipped order?
task: You need the most recently modified file first, then the same view by size. Which flags sort by time modified and by size, and which flag flips any sort order?

q: Where does lsd look for configuration?
task: You want to test a theme without touching the default setup. Which flag points lsd at a custom config file, and what is the default Unix config directory under XDG?

q: How do you isolate a broken icon or color setup?
task: The first character of each entry is trimmed and custom colors do not apply. Which two flags isolate the problem from icons and config, and which environment variable carries the custom color scheme?

From the repo root run rg -n sort work/lsd-ls/src/lsd.md. Paste the first three match lines, state their line numbers, and name the flag documented on line 80.
From the repo root run rg -n alias work/lsd-ls/src/README.md. Paste the first three match lines, state their line numbers, and name the alias defined on line 97.

From the repo root run rg -n XDG_CONFIG_HOME|LS_COLORS work/lsd-ls/src/README.md work/lsd-ls/src/lsd.md. Paste the match lines, state which file each comes from, and quote the default config path on README line 125.
